description: Only after an Ania tool returned an approval link (approvalId) and the user says they clicked "Approve spend" on avatar.diatech.solutions: checks the approval with Ania and runs the action (avatar creation, adjustment, wake-word training, marketplace purchase…). If it is not approved yet, nothing happens.

approvalId.description: The approvalId returned with the link.

language.description: The user's language as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'). Replies and prices follow it.

name: confirm_spend
title: Finish an approved action
